title: Whole Hooded Trumpet Pitcher Plant
description: One newly authored complete stylized trumpet-pitcher plant: a gently asymmetric tapered hollow leaf rises from a small rooted crown, widens into an everted oval mouth and has a real deep blind interior. A separately editable thick curved hood grows from its rear neck and overarches the opening without sealing it; a narrow front leaf flange and two spreading lanceolate basal leaves complete the organic whole. Not a ceramic jug with handle, a shallow fungus cap or a multiple-cup seedhead. One plant prop zero scenes; no exact botanical species, biological capture, digestion, cultivation, growth, ecological or medical claim. Static matte low-poly visual geometry only.
